title: Reading lab: John 11:17–27
subtitle: Read dialogue, condition, and confession in sequence.
overview: This dialogue moves through grief, an unreal-looking condition, a promise, a question, and a confession. Map each claim before discussing the passage’s theology.
Pay special attention to direct speech boundaries and to how Martha’s replies respond to Jesus’ preceding words.

items.grc: εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἀνάστασις καὶ ἡ ζωή.
items.en: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life.”

items.grc: ναί, κύριε· ἐγὼ πεπίστευκα ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ.
items.en: Yes, Lord; I have believed that you are the Christ, the Son of God.
